title: Members
noGithubHint: Commits are not attributed until a login is mapped.
twoFactorMissing: Two-step sign-in is required for this role
noMatchBody: Try another name, or clear the role filter.

invites.title: Waiting to join
invites.revokeBody: The link stops working right away. You can invite the same person again later.
invites.resendBody: The previous link to {email} no longer works. This one works once, for 7 days.
invites.emptyBody: Everyone you invited has joined. Invite someone when you need to.
invites.emptyBodySole: Invite the first member to join you in this project.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a member
inviteDialog.emailHint: Hub emails the link to this address when real email is set up, and you can always copy or share it.
inviteDialog.emailTaken: An active invite exists for this address.
inviteDialog.emailMember: This address belongs to a member.
inviteDialog.ownerOnly: Only an owner can grant the owner role.
inviteDialog.createdBody: Send this link to {email}. It opens the join page with the roles you chose, works once, and expires in 7 days.

once.warning: You won’t see this link again. Copy or share it now.

inviteLink.text:
{inviter} invited you to {project} on Hub. Open this link and create your account. It works once, for 7 days:
{url}
inviteLink.textTailnet: How to reach Hub: it runs on {inviter}’s machine inside a private Tailscale network. Install Tailscale from https://tailscale.com/download, sign in with your own account, accept the share of the machine “{machine}” that {inviter} sends you, then open the link.

mail.real: An email with this link went to {email}.
mail.local: No email reached {email}: Hub only has the local test inbox (Mailpit). Send the link yourself.
mail.off: Hub has no mail server, so no email went to {email}. Send the link yourself.

inviteLink.tailnetTitle: Share this machine with them in Tailscale
inviteLink.tailnetBody: Hub opens only inside your tailnet. In the Tailscale admin console, open Machines, choose {machine}, press Share and send them the share link. They install Tailscale, sign in with their own account and accept it.

rolesDialog.title: Roles of {name}
rolesDialog.hint: MCP tokens pick up the new roles on their next request.
rolesDialog.required: A member needs at least one role.
rolesDialog.lastOwner: You can’t remove the owner role from the project’s last owner.
rolesDialog.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change the owner role.

githubDialog.title: GitHub logins of {name}
githubDialog.label: Logins
githubDialog.hint: Separated by commas. The next capture attributes commits to this member, and older change cards update in the background.
githubDialog.invalid: Use valid GitHub logins, separated by commas.

resetDialog.title: Password reset link
resetDialog.body: Send it to {name} over a safe channel. It expires in 24 hours.

disableDialog.title: Disable {name}?
disableDialog.body: They can no longer sign in, their sessions and tokens stop, and their claimed tasks are released. Their work stays in the history, and you can enable them later.

profile.title: My profile
profile.totpRequired: Your role requires it, so it can’t be turned off.
